          Class teacher app

          Class teachers sign in on their phone with the username and password you create below. They see only their own class. They can update guardian, phone, address, date of birth, gender and photo, and add attendance, marks and documents. Everything they save appears here within seconds.

            Backup and restore

            Records are stored in your online college database. A backup downloads a copy to this computer. A full backup also includes uploaded document files. Restoring a backup replaces the online records with the ones in the file.

            Safety copies

            The last 5 copies are kept automatically before risky actions such as imports, deletes, restores and resets. Use one to undo a mistake.
